title: PaymentAllocated
description: Emitted when a payment is broken down into principal, interest, and fees. Replaces the inline PaymentService.allocatePayment() logic.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

occurredAt.description: When the allocation was computed (ISO 8601, UTC).

version.description: Schema version of the event contract.

paymentId.description: Identifier of the payment record being allocated.

loanId.description: Identifier of the loan the payment applies to.

principalAmount.description: Portion of the payment applied to principal, in dollars.

interestAmount.description: Portion of the payment applied to interest, in dollars.

feeAmount.description: Portion of the payment applied to fees, in dollars.
